representation: same frozen BERT token embeddings as 05
target_transform: log1p(story point), expm1 back-transform, clamp at 0
training_pool: development pools of the other 38 projects (target's own pool excluded)
epoch_selection: project-grouped 5-fold CV on a 30k-row sample, CV_MAX_EPOCHS=10, FINAL_EPOCH_CAP=8; folds holding the target out are excluded from that target's average
calibration: per-target affine a*p+b fitted on out-of-fold predictions of the other 38 projects only (target-blind)
